a2a:agent-card.a2a:json: { "protocolVersion": "0.3.0", "name": "Address Change Intake Agent", "description": "Takes a customer's change of address for a bank account. Asks for the account number, the new address and the moving date until all three are given, then issues a receipt number. Say キャンセル to cancel.", "url": "${agent.url}", "version": "1.0.0", "preferredTransport": "JSONRPC", "capabilities": { "streaming": false, "pushNotifications": false, "stateTransitionHistory": true }, "defaultInputModes": ["text/plain"], "defaultOutputModes": ["text/plain", "application/json"], "skills": [ { "id": "address-change", "name": "住所変更の受付", "description": "口座番号・新しい住所・転居日をそろえて住所変更を受け付け、受付番号を返す。足りない項目は聞き返す。", "tags": ["banking", "address-change", "intake"], "examples": [ "住所変更をお願いします", "口座 1002-0002、新住所は 東京都板橋区大山町1-2-3、10月1日に引っ越します" ] } ] }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var p = if (payload is String) read(payload, "application/json") else payload var parts = p.message.parts default [] var texts = (parts filter ((x) -> (x.kind default x."type" default "") == "text")) map ((x) -> x.text default "") --- { jsonRpcMethod: attributes.jsonRpcMethod, attrTaskId: attributes.taskId, attrContextId: attributes.contextId, msgTaskId: p.message.taskId, msgContextId: p.message.contextId, referenceTaskIds: p.message.referenceTaskIds, messageId: p.message.messageId, text: texts joinBy "\n" }

set-variable.value: 住所変更の受付を取り消しました。

#[%dw 2.0 output text/plain var got = vars.intake.fields filterObject ((v) -> v != null) --- (if (isEmpty(got)) '住所変更を承ります。' else ('受け付けた内容: ' ++ ((got pluck ((v, k) -> (k as String) ++ '=' ++ v)) joinBy ', ') ++ '。')) ++ ' 次を教えてください: ' ++ (vars.intake.missing joinBy '、')]
#['住所変更を受け付けました。受付番号 ' ++ vars.receipt ++ '（口座 ' ++ vars.intake.fields.accountNumber ++ '、新住所 ' ++ vars.intake.fields.newAddress ++ '、転居日 ' ++ vars.intake.fields.movingDate ++ '）。']

os:store.doc:name: Log the call
os:store.key: #[(now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) as String ++ '-' ++ uuid()[0 to 7]]
os:store.os:value: #[output application/json --- { in: vars.req, out: { taskId: vars.taskId, contextId: vars.contextId, state: vars.state } }]

os:store.doc:name: Log the call
os:store.key: #[(now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) as String ++ '-' ++ uuid()[0 to 7]]
os:store.os:value: #[output application/json --- { in: { jsonRpcMethod: attributes.jsonRpcMethod, attrTaskId: attributes.taskId, attrContextId: attributes.contextId }, out: { authorized: true } }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- (payload pluck ((v, k) -> { key: k as String, call: read(v as String, "application/json") })) orderBy $.key map $.call
